summary: Frontend-only Playwright regression on new 'Consumi e ricavi mezzi' module (/mezzi). Flow verified: login with password 'admin'; Home tile data-testid=cta-mezzi exists and navigates to /mezzi (mezzi-page). Create mezzo via mezzi-nuovo-mezzo → mezzo-dialog with mezzo-nome='Camion Test' + mezzo-targa='ZZ999ZZ' + mezzo-salva creates mezzo and shows mezzi-filtro-<id>. Three movimenti created via mezzi-nuovo-movimento → movimento-dialog (categoria option click, importo, data=first-of-current-month, salva): Incasso 500, Carburante 120.50, Pedaggio 30. Row mezzi-mese-<N> correctly shows '500,00 €', '120,50 €', '30,00 €', Tot. spese '150,50 €', Parziale '349,50 €' (verde). Clicking the month row filters movimenti list to 3 rows; 'Mostra tutto l'anno' (mezzi-mese-reset) removes the filter. Edit via mov-edit-* changes importo to 40 and totale updates. Delete via mov-del-* + confirm-ok removes a row and updates totale. Filtro mezzo mezzi-filtro-<id> and mezzi-filtro-tutti both work. mezzi-pdf opens pdf-preview-overlay. Deleting mezzo while movimenti exist (mezzo-del-<id> + confirm-ok) shows error toast 'Il mezzo ha N movimenti registrati: eliminali prima'. Cleanup via all mov-del-* then mezzo-del-<id> succeeds (toast 'Mezzo eliminato'). Note: the TOTALE 2026 row initially showed values exceeding the Oct row because a stale 'Camion Test' mezzo (plus 4 movimenti) was leftover from a prior iteration — my selector picked the first filtro button which was that leftover; the newly-created mezzo (7959aa68) was collected and deleted via API after the test to leave an empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: Mezzi.jsx: TabellaAnno row click toggles mese filter correctly; parziale color via cls() works (verde for positive).
MezziDialogs.jsx MovimentoDialog uses Number(f.importo) with >0 guard and defaults mezzo_id to mezzoDefault || mezzi[0]?.id — robust.
backend/routers/mezzi.py riepilogo properly filters by mezzo_id when provided and PDF endpoint reuses _riepilogo; delete mezzo refuses when movimenti exist (correct 400).

Minor: previous iterations may have left seed data for /mezzi. Consider ensuring testing agents always query backend to get the exact just-created mezzo id instead of DOM first-filtro to avoid picking stale data.
seed_data_creation: Test created one 'Camion Test' mezzo + 3 movimenti; cleaned up at end. One orphan from prior iteration (id 7959aa68) was additionally deleted via API; backend /api/mezzi now returns [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mezzi feature at /mezzi uses data-testids: cta-mezzi (home), mezzi-page, mezzi-pdf, mezzi-nuovo-mezzo, mezzo-dialog, mezzo-nome, mezzo-targa, mezzo-note, mezzo-salva, mezzi-filtro-tutti, mezzi-filtro-<id>, mezzo-edit-<id>, mezzo-del-<id>, mezzi-anno, mezzi-nuovo-movimento, movimento-dialog, mov-mezzo, mov-data, mov-categoria, mov-importo, mov-descrizione, mov-salva, mezzi-tabella-anno, mezzi-mese-<1..12>, mezzi-mese-reset, mezzi-totale-anno, mov-riga-<id>, mov-edit-<id>, mov-del-<id>, confirm-ok, pdf-preview-overlay. Backend endpoints /api/mezzi, /api/mezzi/movimenti, /api/mezzi/riepilogo, /api/mezzi/riepilogo.pdf, /api/mezzi/anni all verified via UI integration. When picking the newly-created mezzo filtro button, use a selector tied to the latest API list rather than the first DOM match to avoid stale leftovers.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Only a test-authoring note: initial TOTALE 2026 apparent discrepancy was explained by a stale leftover mezzo from a prior iteration whose first-DOM-match filtro I selected; all expected per-cell values on the current-month row matched the spec exactly (Incassi 500,00 € · Carburante 120,50 € · Pedaggi 30,00 € · Tot. spese 150,50 € · Parziale 349,50 € verde).
